subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent status-card visibility setting, and when it is disabled should `session_status` return structured data, reduced text, or no rendered card?
rationale: The issue proposes a new configuration surface across two consumers with materially different audiences, so source inspection cannot determine the intended durable contract.

options.title: Chat-only presentation control
options.body: Add an opt-in setting that suppresses the card sent by chat `/status` while preserving the agent tool’s current status information.

options.title: Shared suppression contract
options.body: Apply one setting to both callers and define an explicit replacement payload for `session_status`.

options.title: Reject persistent configuration
options.body: Keep the existing status output and address clutter through a different command or caller-level presentation design.

recommendation.title: Chat-only presentation control
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in setting that suppresses the card sent by chat `/status` while preserving the agent tool’s current status information.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue’s prior canonical-tracker decision and the relevant recent status-path history connect this person most directly to the required product choice.
